observations.content: Assistant inspected subagent-types extension index.ts at /home/coder/workspaces/learn/.pi/extensions/subagent-types to understand model and thinking resolution logic.

Model resolution precedence in index.ts: role .md pin (strict, wins over everything, override param ignored; unpinned-model unavailable triggers MODEL_FALLBACK then refuses spawn), else caller params.model override (must be in scoped models list), else guided-choice text instructing caller to re-call.
Thinking resolution in index.ts: pin makes it fixed; non-reasoning model (lacking [T] tag) forced to off; thinking levels enum off|minimal|low|medium|high|xhigh|max; provider family 'pi'.

Assistant corrected earlier mistake: scan-vision agent actually ran MiniMax-M3 (scout.md pins it), not glm-5.3-flash, because override was ignored; confirmed via paseo_get_agent_activity on archived id fa19ce57.

scan-vision agent (MiniMax-M3) successfully read and transcribed a scanned fake invoice image: CONG TY TNHH PI-TEST, HOA DON BAN LE so 001-2026, TONG CONG 980.000 VND, consistent with line items 2 x 250.000d + 1 x 480.000d.
paseo_list_models requires a provider argument; empty args returns error -32602 Invalid arguments: expected string for provider, received undefined.
paseo_list_models for provider 'pi' returns 5 models: deepseek-v4-flash [T], glm-5.2 [T], glm-5.3 [T][XL], glm-5.3-flash [T][V][XL], MiniMax-M3 [T][V][L]; all default thinking option is medium.

Vision model tags confirmed: glm-5.3 (main) lacks [V]; glm-5.3-flash [V]; MiniMax-M3 [V]; deepseek-v4-flash and glm-5.2 lack [V]. Recommendation to switch scout to glm-5.3-flash still stands due to MiniMax's think-leak, not vision.

Assistant explained why main agent cannot actually override role model: model is not a security boundary, only quality/cost; real boundaries are role-declared tool allowlist and extension-stamped labels subagent.role/subagent.parent; create_agent payload is built by extension, not the model.
User asked why it is still paused ('Tại sao còn pause?').

paseo_list_agents shows 5 agents: /om (cf76ad71, running, attentionReason finished at 14:05:54), scan-vision (fa19ce57, idle, MiniMax-M3, labels scout with parent cf76ad71), github profile agent, HANDOFF-observational-memory agent, and ask-user-questions agent (closed).
Assistant re-archived scan-vision (fa19ce57) because earlier archive returned success but record still showed archivedAt null; second archive also returned success true.
om_status healthy: 0/4 observers in flight, 239 active observations, consolidator idle, last error none, 7 topic files, session cost $0.1550 (31 runs).
User clarified the pause: the working icon keeps spinning and timer keeps running but no streaming, no thinking, no subagent waiting, no tool call visible, which normally means it already stopped.

Assistant concluded two causes for the spinner-without-output: A) silent long tool execution (ffmpeg ~100MB curl 30-60s, sleep 50 waiting for worker, MCP calls, 14-page PDF fetch ~10s) which stream nothing; B) real Paseo bug where finish notification is dropped mid-turn leaving spinner running forever (daemon shows status running alongside attentionReason finished); advised distinguishing by whether the final answer is complete.

Assistant stated the 13:44 user stop was case A (stop was incorrect, agent was only in sleep 50), causing a System Error abort and lost turn progress; bug B is a Paseo daemon-side notify-drop bug not fixable from their extensions.

User corrected: their time is 9:09pm 30/08/2026 GMT+7, and the pause happened recently, not during tool downloads; the last visible text from the assistant was 'Muốn trải nghiệm cơ chế (2) thật: bỏ dòng model: khỏi một role .md — khi đó mọi spawn role đó sẽ buộc caller chọn model per-task.'
